name: audiocast-control
title: AudioCast Control
description: Control your AudioCast device using Raycast
author: RomiC

preferences.name: minimalVolume
preferences.title: Minimal volume
preferences.description: Specify the minimal volume level which can be set w/ a single "Set Minimal Volume" command. Between 0 and 100.

preferences.name: normalVolume
preferences.title: Normal volume
preferences.description: Specify the normal volume level which can be set w/ a single "Set Normal Volume" command. Between 0 and 100.

preferences.name: highVolume
preferences.title: High volume
preferences.description: Specify the high volume level which can be set w/ a single "Set High Volume" command. Between 0 and 100.

commands.name: radio
commands.title: Radio
commands.subtitle: AudioCast
commands.description: Play online radio station on AudioCast device

commands.name: setVolume
commands.title: Set Volume Level
commands.subtitle: AudioCast
commands.description: Set certain volume on AudioCast device

commands.name: setMinimalVolume
commands.title: Set Minimal Volume
commands.subtitle: AudioCast
commands.description: Set volume on AudioCast device to minimal level specified in preferences

commands.name: setNormalVolume
commands.title: Set Normal Volume
commands.subtitle: AudioCast
commands.description: Set volume on AudioCast device to normal level specified in preferences

commands.name: setHighVolume
commands.title: Set High Volume
commands.subtitle: AudioCast
commands.description: Set volume on AudioCast device to high level specified in preferences

commands.name: toggleMute
commands.title: Toggle Mute/Unmute
commands.subtitle: AudioCast
commands.description: Decrease volume on AudioCast device to 0 or restore previous volume
